correctness.rationale: Stationary force covariance e^(−c|t|) gives S_X(ω)=2cf²/[(ω²+c²)((p−ω²)²+q²ω²)]. Its numerator and monic cubic in z=ω² are observed. For q²<4p the mechanical quadratic is irreducible over ℝ, so the unique real linear factor marks c, then q,p,f. If q²≥4p, mechanical rates a,b>0 have a+b=q, ab=p; the spectral cubic determines their unordered multiset with telegraph c and each distinct selection c yields exactly one positive realization, including repeated poles. Overdamped causal Green kernel g(t)≥0 has integral 1/p; stationary σ with no flips on any finite interval has positive probability, so essential support R=f/p exactly. Writing U=abc gives R²=Kc/U², K=cf², and identifies c unambiguously. Independently checked three exact aliases with poles 1,2,3 and K=6, discriminants, support inversions and generator stationary moments. Exact-population observables only; no finite-sample inference.
